decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates target the emerging glass-core and advanced packaging market, where uncertainty is still high and the upside is large, and keeping this flagship option open costs little because it builds on the firm's existing glass processing know-how, so there is no reason to abandon it yet.

Laser-based through-glass via structuring was launched only in 2024 and given its own page as a next-generation flagship, so its value is still unresolved and it complements Product A in the glass packaging strategy, which makes keeping the option clearly preferable to dropping it.
